turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A chilled coffee is definitely a must in that Arizona sun! Did you have some time to relax, or maybe do a bit of baking before your shift?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually kept it pretty low-key today. But for lunch, I made myself a really nice sandwich using a couple of slices of my home-baked wild yeast loaf. It hit the spot.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ooh, a fresh wild yeast sandwich sounds incredible. You really can't beat home-baked bread. Are you getting ready to head over to the hospital soon?

turns.text: Yep, I'm just getting my things together. I'm taking the late-evening transit bus tonight, so I need to leave a little earlier than usual to catch it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I hope the ride is smooth and peaceful! Do you have a good book or some music lined up to pass the time during the commute?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually have a hilarious audio show queued up. It's this comedy program where two guys just joke about the weirdest internet stories they can find. It's sure to keep me laughing on the way.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a great way to boost your mood before a busy night shift in the ER. Have you and Tom been able to find some time to connect recently, despite your hectic hours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We have, thankfully! We actually managed to grab an early dinner together yesterday before I had to sleep. It was really nice to catch up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful. It's so nice when you can sync up your schedules like that. I hope your shift tonight isn't too overwhelming!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks so much! I appreciate it. I'll check in with you tomorrow when I'm back. Have a good night!
